alias-of:ramah_976>ramoth-gilead_984@ff8.note: Joram is wounded in the same fight with Hazael, 'in Ramothgilead' (8.28) and 'at Ramah' (8.29). Treating the two spellings as one place is a reading.

birth:ahaziah_121@629f51.note: Age 22 at accession (8.26), which began in Joram's twelfth year (8.25). The year depends on dating outside Scripture.

birth:amaziah_214@d268b0.note: Age 25 when he began to reign (14.2), at Joash's death (12.21). The year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:death-of-jehoahash@3a5d08.note: Jehoash of Israel reigned sixteen years from Joash's 37th year (13.10); the year depends on dating outside Scripture. Name 'Jehoahash' is a spelling reading.

date:death-of-jehoahaz@112309.note: Jehoahaz reigned seventeen years from Joash's 23rd year (13.1), then died (13.9). The year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:death-of-jehoram@62b673.note: Eight-year reign in Jerusalem (8.17), then he slept with his fathers (8.24). The year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:death-of-jehu@e97582.note: Jehu reigned twenty-eight years over Israel (10.36), then died (10.35). The year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:elijah-translated@f74fb5.note: The text gives no year for the translation (2.1). The year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:prophecies-of-elisha@69be1c.note: From Elijah's translation (2.1) to Elisha's death (13.20). The years depend on dating outside Scripture.

date:reign-of-ahaziah-jehoahaz@91a96f.note: Began in Joram's twelfth year (8.25) and reigned one year (8.26). The years depend on dating outside Scripture.

date:reign-of-athaliah@f91d8d.note: Athaliah reigned while Joash was hidden six years (11.3), until the seventh year (11.4). The years depend on dating outside Scripture.

date:reign-of-jehoahaz@4fd95d.note: Began in Joash's 23rd year and reigned seventeen years (13.1). The years depend on dating outside Scripture.

date:reign-of-jehoash@abb825.note: Began in Joash of Judah's 37th year and reigned sixteen years (13.10). The years depend on dating outside Scripture.

date:reign-of-jehoram@6cbdb7.note: Began in Joram of Israel's fifth year (8.16) and reigned eight years (8.17). The years depend on dating outside Scripture.

date:reign-of-jehu@90604b.note: Reigned twenty-eight years over Israel (10.36). The start year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:reign-of-joash@a9e5b9.note: Began at seven years old (11.21) and reigned forty years in Jerusalem (12.1). The years depend on dating outside Scripture.

date:reign-of-joram@4437bb.note: Began in Jehoshaphat's eighteenth year and reigned twelve years (3.1). The years depend on dating outside Scripture.

death:ahaziah_121@62b673.note: After a one-year reign (8.26), he fled to Megiddo and died there (9.27). The year depends on dating outside Scripture.

death:amaziah_214@1c91d2.note: Reigned twenty-nine years (14.2) and lived fifteen years after Jehoash's death (14.17). The year depends on dating outside Scripture.

death:athaliah_359@a6d37c.note: Slain after her reign of about six years (11.3), beside the king's house (11.20). The year depends on dating outside Scripture.

death:joash_1632@daf459.note: Reigned forty years in Jerusalem (12.1), then was slain by his servants (12.20). The year depends on dating outside Scripture.

died-at:athaliah_359>jerusalem_636@9eb4b.note: Slain by the way the horses came into the king's house, in the city (11.16, 11.20). Ch. 11 never names Jerusalem; the identification is a reading.

died-at:joash_1632>jerusalem_636@91614b.note: Reigned in Jerusalem (12.1) and was buried in the city of David (12.21). The death place, the house of Millo (12.20), is not named as Jerusalem.

member-of:ahaziah_121>tribe-of-judah@40e.note: Called king of Judah (8.25) in a line from Jehoshaphat (8.16). Descent to the tribe of Judah is outside this passage.

member-of:amaziah_214>tribe-of-judah@aed.note: Called Amaziah the son of Joash, king of Judah (14.1). Descent to the tribe of Judah is outside this passage.

member-of:jehoshabeath_811>tribe-of-juda.note: Daughter of king Joram of Judah and sister of Ahaziah (11.2). Descent to the tribe of Judah is outside this passage.

member-of:joash_1632>tribe-of-judah@a34d.note: Reigned as king in Jerusalem (12.1), son of Ahaziah king of Judah (11.2). Descent to the tribe of Judah is outside this passage.

occurred-at:death-of-jehoahash>samaria_1.note: Buried in Samaria (13.13), where his reign was (13.10). The place of death is not stated.

occurred-at:death-of-jehoahaz>samaria_10.note: Buried in Samaria (13.9). The place of death is not stated.

occurred-at:death-of-jehoram>jerusalem_6.note: Buried in the city of David (8.24), where he reigned in Jerusalem (8.17). The place of death is not stated.

occurred-at:death-of-jehu>samaria_1022@9.note: Buried in Samaria (10.35). The place of death is not stated.

occurred-at:reign-of-athaliah>jerusalem_.note: Athaliah reigned over the land (11.3), from the king's house in the city (11.20). Ch. 11 does not name Jerusalem.

occurred-at:reign-of-jehu>samaria_1022@5.note: Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty-eight years (10.36). The matched 10.1 only has letters sent to Samaria.

parent-of:ahab_113>athaliah_359@6a7538.note: 8.18 calls Jehoram's wife 'the daughter of Ahab'; 8.26 calls Athaliah 'the daughter of Omri'. The text gives two different fathers.

parent-of:jehoram_803>jehoshabeath_811@9.note: 'Jehosheba, the daughter of king Joram' (11.2). The spelling Jehoshabeath is from outside this passage.

parent-of:rechab_2403>jonadab_799@0053a1.note: 'Jehonadab the son of Rechab' (10.15). The spelling Jonadab is a reading.

parent-of:shimeath_2683>zabad_1746@85f03.note: 12.21 names Jozachar, son of Shimeath. The name Zabad is from outside this passage.

parent-of:shimrith_2724>jehozabad_812@67.note: 12.21 says Jehozabad is 'the son of Shomer'. Shimrith is not named as his parent here.

part-of:sur_1117>jerusalem_636@e15ae9.note: The gate of Sur is one of the guard posts for the king's house and the LORD's house (11.5-7). Jerusalem is not named in the text.

participated-in:athaliah_359>reign-of-at.note: Athaliah did reign over the land (11.3). The matched 11.1 shows her killing the royal seed, not her reign.

participated-in:elisha_1153>prophecies-o.note: Elisha speaks 'Thus saith the LORD' to the kings (3.16). The matched 2.15 does not show a prophecy.

participated-in:jehoram_803>reign-of-jeh.note: Judah's Jehoram began to reign in Joram of Israel's fifth year and reigned eight years in Jerusalem (8.16-17). The matched 1.17 is about Israel's Jehoram.

participated-in:jehu_817>reign-of-jehu@f.note: Jehu is anointed king over Israel (9.6) and reigned there twenty-eight years (10.36). The matched 9.2 is the errand to anoint him.

participated-in:joash_1633>death-of-jeho.note: Joash of Israel dies (13.13). The event name 'Jehoahash' is a spelling of Jehoash, outside this passage.

partner-of:ahaziah_121>zibiah_3064@e5978.note: Joash is Ahaziah's son (11.2) and Zibiah is Joash's mother (12.1). The marriage is inferred, not stated.

partner-of:athaliah_359>jehoram_803@1026.note: Jehoram's wife was Ahab's daughter (8.18), and Athaliah was Ahaziah's mother, Ahaziah being Jehoram's son (8.25-26). The marriage is inferred.
